# Configuration reference

<!-- GENERATED by `uv run python -m app.tools.docs_config`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every setting is an environment variable (upper-case name), read by `app/config.py` (pydantic-settings; a `.env` file is also read).
Copy `.env.example` to start. Settings marked **required in production** make the service refuse to start without them.

| Variable | Default | Required | Example | What it does | Security notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ENV` | `'dev'` | no | `production` | Deployment mode. `production` enforces required secrets, https sources and forbids private sources. | Never run production with `dev`. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `'sqlite:///./data/intelligence.db'` | no | `postgresql+psycopg://user:pass@db/intelligence` | SQLAlchemy URL. SQLite by default; PostgreSQL via `postgresql+psycopg://...` (install the `postgres` extra). | Contains credentials for PostgreSQL: inject from a secret store. |
| `AUTO_MIGRATE` | `true` | no | `true` | Run Alembic `upgrade head` at startup (`env=test` uses `create_all`). | Disable when migrations are run by a release job. |
| `MODEL_DIR` | `'./data/models'` | no | `/var/lib/intelligence/models` | Directory for joblib model artifacts (per account/type/version, sha256 verified on load). | Must be writable only by the service: artifacts are pickles and are trusted input. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `'INFO'` | no | `INFO` | Log level for the JSON logger. | Logs never contain secrets; keys named key/secret/token/password/pepper are redacted. |
| `KEK` | (empty) | **yes (production)** | `generate: python -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"` | Comma separated urlsafe-base64 32-byte Fernet keys. The first encrypts, all decrypt (rotation). Encrypts source API keys and identity peppers at rest. | REQUIRED in production. Losing it makes stored source credentials unreadable. In dev a public insecure key is used. |
| `ADMIN_API_KEY` | (empty) | **yes (production)** | `a 32+ char random string` | Separate platform-operator key for `/admin` (header `X-Admin-Key`). Empty disables the admin API. | REQUIRED in production. Not a tenant key; compared in constant time. |
| `JWT_SECRET` | (empty) | no | `a 32+ char random string` | HS256 secret enabling `POST /v1/auth/token` (API key -> short-lived JWT). Empty disables JWT. | Rotate by redeploying; existing tokens die at expiry. |
| `JWT_TTL_S` | `3600` | no | `3600` | JWT lifetime in seconds. | Keep short. |
| `METRICS_TOKEN` | (empty) | no | `a random string` | If set, `/metrics` requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. | Set it unless `/metrics` is only reachable on a private network. |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | (empty) | no | `https://app.example.com` | Comma separated CORS allow-list. Empty means no CORS headers. | Never use `*`. |
| `MAX_BODY_BYTES` | `1000000` | no | `1000000` | Maximum accepted request body (Content-Length) in bytes. |  |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN` | `600` | no | `600` | Token-bucket refill per API key (per IP is 2x). In-memory, per instance. | Behind several instances the effective limit multiplies. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_BURST` | `60` | no | `60` | Token-bucket capacity per API key (per IP is 2x). |  |
| `ALLOW_PRIVATE_SOURCES` | `false` | no | `false` | Allow source URLs that resolve to private, loopback or link-local addresses (SSRF guard off). | Dev/test only. Forbidden in production (startup fails). |
| `CONNECTOR_TIMEOUT_S` | `30.0` | no | `30` | Per-request timeout for source calls. |  |
| `CONNECTOR_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `5` | no | `5` | Attempts per request (retries use exponential backoff with full jitter). |  |
| `CONNECTOR_BACKOFF_BASE_S` | `0.5` | no | `0.5` | Backoff base in seconds. |  |
| `CONNECTOR_BACKOFF_MAX_S` | `30.0` | no | `30` | Backoff ceiling in seconds. A `Retry-After` above 60 s is surfaced and the job is rescheduled instead of sleeping. |  |
| `CONNECTOR_PAGE_LIMIT` | `1000` | no | `1000` | Rows per list page (contract maximum 1000); also the fallback export page size. |  |
| `CONNECTOR_EXPORT_PAGE_LIMIT` | `5000` | no | `5000` | Rows requested per NDJSON export page. Exports are limited to 10 requests per minute per key, so pages are large (Funnels allows 20,000, Conversations 5,000); a source that answers 400 gets `connector_page_limit` instead. |  |
| `CONNECTOR_MAX_RETRY_AFTER_S` | `120.0` | no | `120` | Longest `Retry-After` honoured by sleeping inside one request. A longer penalty (the apps escalate to minutes after repeated 429s) fails that resource with its cursor kept, so the next sync resumes. |  |
| `CONNECTOR_MAX_BAD_LINE_RATIO` | `0.05` | no | `0.05` | Fraction of malformed NDJSON lines tolerated per page before the sync fails with a schema error. | A truncated final line is always retried, never skipped. |
| `MIN_SCHEMA_VERSION` | `1` | no | `1` | Oldest source `schema_version` accepted. |  |
| `MAX_SCHEMA_VERSION` | `1` | no | `1` | Newest tested `schema_version`; newer sources only produce a warning (additive contract). |  |
| `BACKFILL_DAYS` | `180` | no | `180` | History fetched on the first sync of a resource. Values above 365 are clamped: the apps refuse a `from`/`to` range over 366 days with a 400. |  |
| `LOOKBACK_DAYS` | `30` | no | `30` | Trailing window re-read for mutable resources (leads, rooms) and rollups on every sync. |  |
| `INGEST_CHUNK_ROWS` | `5000` | no | `5000` | Rows buffered before a DB write and cursor checkpoint. Bounds memory and resume granularity. |  |
| `WORKER_ENABLED` | `false` | no | `true` | Run the in-process job worker (sync/train jobs). | Run exactly one worker per database unless the queue is replaced. |
| `WORKER_POLL_S` | `2.0` | no | `2` | Worker idle poll interval. |  |
| `SYNC_INTERVAL_S` | `0` | no | `900` | Enqueue a sync for every account whose last sync is older than this. 0 disables the scheduler. |  |
| `COLUMNAR_DIR` | (empty) | no | `/var/lib/intelligence/columnar` | Root of the partitioned Parquet event store (`<dir>/<account>/events/bucket=NN`). When set, every synced event chunk is also appended there and contact profiles can be refreshed incrementally and out-of-core. | Same trust level as the model directory. |
| `COLUMNAR_BUCKETS` | `32` | no | `32` | Hash buckets (by contact key) of the Parquet store: independent units of memory bounding and worker fan-out. Fixed for the life of the store. | Changing it requires rebuilding the store. |
| `ACCOUNT_MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS` | `2` | no | `2` | Per-account cap on simultaneously running jobs; the queue picks the account with the fewest running jobs first (fair scheduling). | Noisy-neighbour protection. |
| `ACCOUNT_MAX_EVENT_ROWS` | `0` | no | `0` | Per-account cap on landed event rows (0 = unlimited). A sync that would exceed it fails with a budget error. | Protects storage and shared workers. |
| `ML_MAX_TRAINING_ROWS` | `500000` | no | `500000` | Training uses at most this many most-recent labelled rows per model. | Bounds training time and memory per account. |
| `MODEL_CACHE_SIZE` | `32` | no | `32` | Loaded model artifacts kept in memory (LRU). A promote or rollback swaps the active model without a restart. |  |
| `BATCH_MAX_ROWS` | `5000` | no | `5000` | Maximum rows per `POST /v1/leads/score/batch` request. |  |
| `SEED` | `1234` | no | `1234` | Base random seed for every model (reproducible training). |  |
| `LABEL_HORIZON_DAYS` | `14` | no | `14` | Lead conversion label window: order within N days of opt-in. Also the embargo between train and validation. | Per-account override via account settings `label_horizon_days`. |
| `MIN_LEADS_FOR_MODEL` | `300` | no | `300` | Below this many mature labelled leads the documented heuristic is used. |  |
| `MIN_CLASS_COUNT` | `30` | no | `30` | Minimum examples of each class in train and validation for a GBM. |  |
| `MIN_ROOMS_FOR_MODEL` | `300` | no | `300` | Below this many labelled rooms the SLA heuristic is used. |  |
| `MIN_CONTACTS_FOR_SEGMENTS` | `100` | no | `100` | Below this many contacts segments are rule-based. |  |
| `SLA_FIRST_RESPONSE_S` | `3600` | no | `3600` | Default first-response SLA in seconds. Per-account override: account settings `sla_first_response_s`. |  |
| `VIP_REVENUE_THRESHOLD` | `500.0` | no | `500` | Lifetime funnel revenue that marks a contact VIP in conversation ranking. Per-account override: `vip_revenue_threshold`. |  |
| `TRAIN_TIME_BUDGET_S` | `120.0` | no | `120` | Soft training time budget; exceeding it is recorded in the model metrics. |  |
| `PSI_WARN` | `0.1` | no | `0.1` | PSI at or above which drift is `warn`. |  |
| `PSI_ALERT` | `0.25` | no | `0.25` | PSI at or above which drift is `alert`. |  |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | (empty) | no | `sk-ant-...` | Enables the LLM layer. Empty uses the deterministic TemplateNarrator and offline Q&A. | Secret. Prompts contain only aggregates and sanitised names, never contact keys or emails. |
| `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` | `'claude-sonnet-5-5'` | no | `claude-sonnet-5-5` | Model id used by the Anthropic client. |  |
| `LLM_TIMEOUT_S` | `30.0` | no | `30` | Per-call LLM timeout; failures fall back to templates. |  |
| `LLM_MAX_INPUT_CHARS` | `24000` | no | `24000` | Input budget per LLM call; larger prompts are refused (template fallback). | Cost control. |
| `LLM_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` | `1024` | no | `1024` | max_tokens per LLM call. | Cost control. |
| `LLM_DAILY_CALL_CAP` | `200` | no | `200` | Per-account daily LLM call cap (cache hits are free). | Cost control. |
| `LLM_DAILY_TOKEN_CAP` | `400000` | no | `400000` | Per-account daily input+output token cap. | Cost control. |
| `LLM_CACHE_TTL_S` | `3600` | no | `3600` | TTL of the identical-prompt response cache. |  |
| `LLM_REDACT_PII` | `true` | no | `true` | Scrub emails, phone numbers and long hex identifiers from prompts. | Leave on. |
| `LLM_MAX_TOOL_STEPS` | `4` | no | `4` | Maximum tool-use rounds for `POST /v1/ask`. |  |

Only `ENV`, `KEK` and `ADMIN_API_KEY` matter for a first production deploy; everything else has a working default.
